newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no sales-private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no sales-private.

text.p: Nebraska's feedlot cattle were lightly bid at $107.00 per cwt on a dressed basis but those bids were passed by owners pricing cattle at $110.00 to mostly $111.00, market sources said.
Sales on Friday were done at $109.00 to $110.50, but most sales last week were at $111.00, with a few at $111.50 to $112.00, they said.

Bids on a live basis were scattered at $67.00 and also passed by owners asking $68.00 to $69.00. Sales last week had a top of $69.00. Showlists this week were projected steady to a little larger than last week.
